scoreMeaning.meaning: Does not satisfy the criterion or introduces a blocking incompatibility.

invariants: Researching records may remain incomplete but cannot claim a recommendation or approval.
Decision-ready candidates are assessed against the same weighted criteria.
Every non-eliminated candidate has current primary evidence.
Categories that require implementation evidence include a completed comparative spike.

AI may prepare a recommendation but cannot approve a UI Generation research decision.
